label: Хотеть
description: A full deck for the mixed-conjugation verb хотеть: singular (хочу/хочешь/хочет) vs plural (хотим/хотите/хотят), past, and infinitive/genitive objects.

missions.phrase: Я очень хочу горячий чай.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular. 1. 'Хочу' shows the к→ч singular present form. 2. 'Горячий чай' is the accusative object of desire. 3. This is the high-frequency 'I want' frame, distinct from the хотим/хотите/хотят plurals.

missions.phrase: Ты хочешь холодной воды?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person singular. 1. 'Хочешь' keeps the к→ч singular stem. 2. 'Холодной воды' is partitive genitive, 'some cold water'. 3. Singular forms share the хоч- stem, unlike plural хотите.

missions.phrase: Он очень хочет домой после работы.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person singular. 1. 'Хочет' is the к→ч singular present, no plural хот- shift. 2. 'Домой' is a directional adverb of destination. 3. A natural everyday line contrasting with plural хотят.

missions.phrase: Мы хотим идти в парк сегодня.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural. 1. 'Хотим' uses the plural хот- stem with no к→ч shift. 2. 'Идти в парк' is an infinitive-of-intention plus destination. 3. The mixed verb switches pattern between singular хочу and plural хотим.

missions.phrase: Вы хотите знать всю правду?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Polite/plural form. 1. 'Хотите' is the plural хот- stem, used for respect or for many people. 2. 'Знать всю правду' is an infinitive complement with object. 3. Plural keeps т, unlike singular хочешь.

missions.phrase: Они очень хотят помочь нам сегодня.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person plural. 1. 'Хотят' is the plural хот- stem with no consonant shift. 2. 'Помочь нам' is a perfective infinitive complement with dative. 3. Plural хотят contrasts sharply with singular хочет.

missions.phrase: Я ужасно хочу спать сейчас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular with infinitive. 1. 'Хочу' is the к→ч singular stem. 2. 'Спать' is the infinitive naming the desired action. 3. Хотеть + infinitive is the standard 'want to do' frame, here in the singular pattern.

missions.phrase: Я так хочу есть после тренировки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular, idiomatic. 1. 'Хочу' is the singular к→ч form. 2. 'Есть' as infinitive means 'to eat', so 'хочу есть' reads 'I'm hungry'. 3. A high-frequency fixed expression in the singular.

missions.phrase: Я очень хочу воды после жары.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 1. 'Хочу' is first-person singular, к→ч. 2. 'Воды' is genitive, signalling 'some water', not the whole. 3. Хотеть + genitive marks a partitive, indefinite amount.

missions.phrase: Я хочу чаю с лимоном, пожалуйста.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Partitive genitive. 1. 'Хочу' is the singular к→ч form. 2. 'Чаю' is the special partitive genitive of чай, 'some tea'. 3. This contrasts with accusative 'хочу чай' (the tea as whole object).

missions.phrase: Ты хочешь крепкий чёрный чай?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Second-person singular, accusative. 1. 'Хочешь' keeps the к→ч singular stem. 2. 'Крепкий чёрный чай' is accusative, naming the thing wanted. 3. Singular forms share the хоч- stem, unlike plural хотите.

missions.phrase: Мы хотим знать ответ прямо сейчас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural. 1. 'Хотим' uses the plural хот- ending with no к→ч shift. 2. 'Знать ответ' is the infinitive complement with object. 3. The mixed verb switches pattern between singular хочу and plural хотим.

missions.phrase: Вы хотите ещё чая или кофе?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Polite plural with genitive. 1. 'Хотите' is the plural хот- stem. 2. 'Чая' is genitive, offering 'some more tea'. 3. Plural forms keep т, unlike the singular к→ч хочешь/хочет.

missions.phrase: Они хотят спать после долгой дороги.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person plural. 1. 'Хотят' is the plural хот- stem, no consonant shift. 2. 'Спать' is the infinitive complement of desire. 3. Plural хотят contrasts sharply with singular хочет.

missions.phrase: Я совсем не хочу есть утром.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negated first-person singular. 1. 'Не' negates the verb. 2. 'Хочу' is the к→ч singular form. 3. 'Есть' is the infinitive, so 'не хочу есть' means 'I'm not hungry'.

missions.phrase: Он совсем не хочет идти туда.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negated third-person singular. 1. 'Не хочет' refuses an action. 2. 'Хочет' keeps the singular к→ч stem, distinct from plural хотят. 3. 'Идти туда' is the infinitive complement of refusal.

missions.phrase: Я давно хотел крепкий чай.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past. 1. 'Хотел' is the past tense with a masculine singular subject. 2. Past forms drop the present хочу/хотим mixed split entirely. 3. 'Крепкий чай' is accusative, the thing wanted.

missions.phrase: Она очень хотела спать вчера вечером.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past. 1. 'Хотела' marks a feminine singular subject. 2. The -ла ending is the regular past feminine, with no к→ч mixed split. 3. 'Спать' is the infinitive complement.

missions.phrase: Растение явно хотело воды и света.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Neuter past with genitive. 1. 'Хотело' agrees with a neuter singular subject (растение). 2. 'Воды и света' is partitive genitive, 'some water and light'. 3. Past tense has no person split, only gender and number.

missions.phrase: Они очень хотели помочь соседям.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural past. 1. 'Хотели' is the past plural for any gender. 2. 'Помочь соседям' is a perfective infinitive with dative. 3. Past plural -ли parallels present хотят but loses the mixed pattern.

missions.phrase: Я скоро захочу горячий чай.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person singular. 1. 'Захочу' is the perfective захотеть, 'I will want', keeping the к→ч singular shift. 2. The за- prefix forms the perfective future. 3. 'Горячий чай' is the accusative object.

missions.phrase: Он вдруг захотел спать прямо днём.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective past. 1. 'Захотел' is the perfective past, 'he suddenly wanted'. 2. The за- prefix marks the onset of desire; past keeps no mixed split. 3. 'Спать' is the infinitive complement.
